Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

IS: 7042 •ma 

8.1 Tolerances on untoleranced dimensions shall be in accordance with best prevalent manufacturing 
practice. 

2.2 The ratchet shall have 1 2 teeth. The ratchet drive shall be of open type. 

3* Designation — A ratchet brace of 260 mm nominal size shall be designated as: 

Brace 250, IS : 7042 

4. IWaterial and Other Requirements — According to IS : 7025- ' Technical supply conditions 
for carpenters' braces '. 

5. IMarkIng — Braces shall be marked with the nominal size, manufacturer's name, initials or recognized 
trade*-mark and the year of manufacture. 

5.1 ISl Certification MarA/ng — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New 
Delhi 110001. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

While preparing this standard assistance has been derived from the specification issued by the 
Chief Inspectorate of General Stores, Kanpur on the subject and the following standards: 

BS 1978 : 1965 Bit braces. British Standards Institution. 

PN-64 Narzedzia do recznej obrobki drewna Korba do swidrow z uchwytem dwuszczeKowym 
D-*54310 (Brace for dritis with two-Jaw chuck }. Poiski Komitet Normalizacyjny.
